title: Australian Lentil Bowl
description: A hearty and nutritious bowl filled with Australian lentils, roasted vegetables, and a hint of spices.
instructions: Peel and chop the sweet potatoes and carrots into 1-inch cubes.
Place the sweet potatoes and carrots on a baking sheet, drizzle with 1 tablespoon of quick olive oil, and season with salt and black pepper.
Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
While the sweet potatoes and carrots are roasting, heat 1 tablespoon of quick olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until softened.
Add the sliced red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the chili powder and garlic powder.
Add the Australian lentils to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, until heated through.
To assemble the bowls, place 1/2 cup of the roasted sweet potatoes and carrots in the bottom of a bowl, followed by the lentil mixture.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
